validationError: Some of the information sent was not valid. Check the fields and try again.
textTooLong: Your thesis is too long. Shorten it to {{max}} characters or fewer and try again.
unauthenticated: Your wallet session is not active. Connect your wallet again to continue.
anonQuotaUsed: You have used your free interpretation. Connect your wallet to interpret again.
walletQuotaUsed: You have used all the interpretations available for this wallet for now. Try again after the quota resets.
botCheckFailed: We could not verify that you are a person. Complete the check and try again.
explanationsUsed: You have reached the question limit for this composition.
outOfScope: We could not find an economic belief in that text. Describe a trend, sector or technology you expect to grow.
interpretationNotReady: A few questions about your thesis are still open. Answer them to see the composition.
interpretationCurated: This suggested thesis cannot be changed that way. Edit the text to write your own version.
walletMismatch: This operation was prepared for a different wallet. Switch back to that wallet or start a new operation.
notFound: We could not find what you asked for. It may have been removed, or it may belong to another wallet.
idempotencyConflict: This request conflicts with an earlier one. Start the action again.
operationInProgress: There is already an operation in progress for this item. Wait for it to finish.
quoteExpired: The quote has expired. Request a new one to continue.
materialChange: The price changed significantly. Review the new quote before you continue.
planInvalid: The plan does not pass the checks. Review the highlighted items and adjust the plan.
instrumentNotApproved: This asset is not approved for investing in VicTy.
instrumentRestricted: This asset is restricted and cannot be traded right now.
instrumentSuspended: Trading in this asset is suspended for now. Try again later.
noRoute: There is no route for this amount and direction right now. Try a different amount or try again later.
insufficientBalance: Your balance is too low for this operation. Reduce the amount or add funds.
transactionRejected: The transaction did not pass our checks, so it was not sent for signing. Prepare the operation again.
rateLimited: Too many attempts in a row. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
aiUnavailable: The interpretation service is not available right now. Try again, or start from a suggested thesis.
upstreamUnavailable: A service we depend on is not responding. Try again in a moment.
internalError: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
networkError: We could not reach VicTy. Check your connection and try again.
unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
